q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
Let me work through this systematically.

## (a) Time left until resolution
Today is August 19, 2026. The Q2 FY2027 earnings release is scheduled for August 26, 2026. This gives us **7 days** until the earnings call where forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 will be announced.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks for NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release for revenue. Based on the research provided:

- Q2 FY2027 midpoint guidance was $91.0 billion (±2%), which was slightly below consensus at the time but current consensus is now $91.85 billion
- Q3 FY2027 consensus estimate is $103.1 billion
- The research explicitly states: "NVIDIA is expected to provide forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 revenue during its Q2 FY2027 earnings release"

The key insight from the research is that Q3 FY2027 consensus sits at **$103.1 billion**. This is the most direct estimate available for what guidance NVIDIA will provide. The range given (99.5-115.5B) brackets this consensus estimate reasonably well, with 103.1B roughly in the middle-to-upper portion of that range.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Weaker-than-expected demand signals during Q2
- Geopolitical constraints tightening (China revenue restrictions expanding beyond current assumptions)
- Data center market saturation concerns emerging
- Margin pressures from increased competition
- Conservative guidance reflecting macro uncertainty
- Historical pattern of NVIDIA sometimes guiding slightly conservative

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Better-than-expected Q2 results signaling accelerating demand
- Removal or relaxation of China revenue restrictions
- Strong AI/data center demand continuing to accelerate
- New product announcements or capacity improvements announced
- Analyst upgrades or positive momentum heading into earnings
- NVIDIA historically has occasionally beaten/raised guidance when confidence is high

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides the most concrete forward guidance estimate: **Q3 FY2027 consensus revenue is $103.1 billion**. This is explicitly stated as the expected guidance for this earnings call.

Additionally, the research notes that:
- Q1 FY2027 showed 85% year-over-year growth with $81.6B revenue
- Q2 FY2027 guidance was $91.0B (±2%)
- The consensus for Q3 FY2027 ($103.1B) implies continued growth, though at a slower YoY rate

The consensus of $103.1B appears to be the best available market estimate for what NVIDIA will guide.

## Reasoning

With only 7 days until the earnings call, the consensus estimate of $103.1B is highly informed by:
- Analyst research and models
- Recent industry trends
- Typical NVIDIA guidance patterns
- Current demand signals

The range provided (99.5-115.5B) is quite wide. Given that consensus is at $103.1B, there's meaningful uncertainty, but this should be the most likely outcome. NVIDIA typically guides with some confidence when they provide numbers, so extreme outliers are less likely.

The most probable scenario is that NVIDIA guides close to the consensus at $103.1B, with perhaps modest deviations up or down based on actual Q2 results and confidence levels.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is expected to provide forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 revenue during its Q2 FY2027 earnings release on August 26, 2026. The consensus revenue estimate for Q3 FY2027 is $103.1 billion, implying continued growth from the Q2 FY2027 consensus of $91.85 billion. This would be unusual, as year-over-year growth rates on such a large base typically decay [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/).

NVIDIA's Q1 FY2027 earnings, reported on May 20, 2026, showed record revenue of $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year. For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA guided revenue of $91.0 billion (plus or minus 2%), excluding any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/). This guidance was slightly below the LSEG average estimate of $86.84 billion at the time [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/), but current consensus for Q2 FY2027 revenue is $91.85 billion, 0.9% above NVIDIA's midpoint [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/), [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors/). The Q3 FY2027 guide and any change to the China revenue assumption will be key points of interest [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/).
